driver_archetypes.rationale: Base car type from Saval et al. Maintained to preserve discharge headway (M1/car) and stopping behavior.
Car violator type for space-seeking capacity. Params copied to match car_saval when p=0.

Base motorcycle type from Saval et al. Share reduced to 0.8 to balance with moto_seeker and match M5/moto_density (observed 0.058 vs simulated >0.1). minGapLat clipped to 0.3m (lower bound) to allow tighter packing near stop line (M4/lat_moto).
Moto violator type for space-seeking (wrong lane, sidewalk). Share increased to 0.2 to match M5/moto_density. Params identical to moto_saval.
Illegal left-turning motorcycles (distribution moto_violator). jmTimegapMinor defaults to 1.0s for box waiting logic.

traci_rules.rationale: Targets M3/share/moto (obs 0.076). Reducing p0 from 0.5 to 0.2 lowers the raw red-running probability to better match observations while keeping total violations reasonable. k=0 keeps no swarm effect as per Saval.
Targets M2/early/moto (obs 0.1466). Setting p=0.1466 matches the observed share of motorcycles creeping over the stop line in the last seconds of red.
Activate wrong-lane seeking (p_wrong_lane=0.2145) to match M8/moto wrong-lane share. q=30m triggers on long queues.
Targets observed behavior where most motorcycles squeeze past standing U-turners. High probability (0.9) and short wait (2s) reflect this aggressive maneuvering.
Targets conservative car behavior around U-turners. Low probability (0.1) matches field observation that cars rarely cut in.
